legacy_pre_cut_selection_status.what_it_means: Each consumer's `replacement.path` and `activation_status` pin the on-disk legacy runtime that the consumer currently reads. No `WEB_DIR` repoint, no atomic cutover, no FastAPI activation is implied — the legacy vanilla frontend continues to be served by FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8765 exactly as it is on `develop`. The verifier (AUTHORED on disk via PR #109 + PR #111; scripts/verify_consumers.py + tests/test_verify_consumers.py) validates the legacy pre-cut runtime against each consumer's `verification.command`; this is a pre-cut legacy-readiness contract, not a post-cut contract.
legacy_pre_cut_selection_status.what_it_does_not_claim: It does NOT claim any Approach A / B / C is selected; it does NOT claim G3 PASS; it does NOT claim a `CONSUMER-READINESS.json` was produced; it does NOT enable `make api` activation under Next.js; it does NOT relax G2/G4/G5/G6 blocking language; it does NOT commit or push any source / tests / scripts / config / Makefile / extension / API.
legacy_pre_cut_selection_status.two_tier_model: G3 selection is **two-tier**. (Tier-1) **Legacy pre-cut selection** does not require G2/G4/G5/G6 PASS and is recorded here for every consumer. (Tier-2) **Approach A atomic-cut selection** requires G2 (reproducible `BUILD-INVENTORY.json`) + G4 (Playwright + Lighthouse parity) + G5 (reproducible hydration baseline) + G6 (`cutover-rehearsal.json` dry-run success) AND is left for PR3d/PR3e; no consumer is flipped to Tier-2 in this planning pass.
legacy_pre_cut_selection_status.truth_preservation: G3 remains `blocked — contract defined; legacy pre-cut selection authored; verifier AUTHORED on disk (PR #109 + PR #111) but G3 still gated by G2/G4/G5/G6 PASS for Tier-2`, not `passed`. G2 PASS, G5 unreproducible, G4/G6 blocked, static-export-unselected, no-FastAPI-activation language is preserved verbatim.

selection_invariants.fail_closed_semantics: ANY consumer with `activation_status: unselected` OR `replacement.status: unselected` => G3 verifier (scripts/verify_consumers.py, AUTHORED on disk via PR #109 + PR #111) MUST exit non-zero AND emit no valid CONSUMER-READINESS.json. With the Tier-1 legacy pre-cut pass authored for every consumer, the fail-closed branch currently does not apply — but the verifier MUST still validate each `verification.command` against the legacy pre-cut runtime on FastAPI; non-zero exits on any `verification.command` re-trigger the fail-closed branch and block the artifact. Tier-2 atomic-cut selection is not in play.
selection_invariants.atomic_cutover_invariant: PR3e activates every consumer in this manifest in a single release; partial activation rejected; atomic boundary = (1) api/server.py:54 WEB_DIR repoint + (2) every active-consumer update enumerated in design.md::§3.1 + (3) Makefile api/web targets + (4) the chosen Approach build artifact. This invariant remains binding for Tier-2 atomic-cut selection and is NOT triggered by the Tier-1 legacy pre-cut pass (no `WEB_DIR` repoint is implied).
selection_invariants.rollback_invariant: git revert <pr3e-sha> restores every current_path simultaneously; partial revert rejected under G1. This invariant remains binding for Tier-2 atomic-cut selection. Tier-1 legacy pre-cut selection does not change the rollback unit; rollback already restores every `current_path` (since `replacement.path` equals `current_path` in Tier-1).
selection_invariants.selection_rule_tier1_legacy_pre_cut: To flip a consumer to Tier-1 `selected (legacy pre-cut)` in this planning pass, the manifest MUST name `replacement.path` equal to or consistent with the on-disk legacy `current_path` AND `replacement.note` MUST document the legacy pre-cut semantics AND `verification.command` MUST point at the legacy runtime reachable on FastAPI's 127.0.0.1:8765 mount (or the equivalent file-reader path). NO G2/G4/G5/G6 PASS is required for Tier-1; Tier-1 is a documentation artifact, not an evidence gate. Every consumer in the current manifest satisfies Tier-1.
selection_invariants.selection_rule_tier2_atomic_cut: To flip a consumer to Tier-2 `selected (atomic-cut)`, the manifest MUST name `replacement.path` + `verification.command` + `verification.expect` for the **new** path AND failing-test evidence for the new path MUST exist AND G2 (`BUILD-INVENTORY.json` reproducible) + G4 (Playwright + Lighthouse parity) + G5 (reproducible hydration baseline) + G6 (`cutover-rehearsal.json` dry-run success) MUST all be `passed`. Static export (Approach A) and any other Approach (B / C) remain unselected until those gates close; no consumer is flipped to Tier-2 in this planning pass.
selection_invariants.combined_selection_rule: Tier-1 is recorded here for every consumer (legacy pre-cut selection). Tier-2 is gated by G2/G4/G5/G6 PASS and lands via PR3d/PR3e; the atomic-cut pass will replace (or augment) Tier-1 entries with new-path replacements inside the `replacement` block while preserving `id`, `current_path`, `verification`, and `rollback`.
